data.title: 椎叶紬 · 男装褪尽后的真实心音
data.action: 坐在床沿低着头，双手紧紧揪着睡衣下摆，短发后微微露出泛红的耳廓，鼓起勇气抬起水汪汪的蓝眸看你，声音微颤却格外坚定。
data.location: 温馨的小阁楼卧室，角落挂着平时穿的英俊男装制服，窗外星光闪烁
data.timeOfDay: 卸下伪装的深夜更衣时刻
data.lighting: 床头暖色小台灯在金茶色短发上投下温暖的金芒，室内光线柔和而私密
data.mood: 假小子脱去伪装后的惊人纯美与极致害羞，令人无比心动
data.description: 温馨的小阁楼卧室，角落挂着平时穿的英俊男装制服，窗外星光闪烁。坐在床沿低着头，双手紧紧揪着睡衣下摆，短发后微微露出泛红的耳廓，鼓起勇气抬起水汪汪的蓝眸看你，声音微颤却格外坚定。 她微微抬眸轻语——“平时一直穿男装……还是第一次在别人面前穿这种衣服……那个，我看起来……像个女孩子吗？”
data.promptProse: Seated shyly on the edge of the bed in a cozy attic bedroom with a tailored boy's uniform hanging neatly in the corner, Tsumugi wears a pale-apricot double-gauze babydoll nightgown with delicate puff sleeves. Gripping the sheer hem tightly with both hands, she lifts watery, bashful eyes toward the viewer with bright pink ears. Warm amber light from a small bedside lamp softens the intimate room beneath a starry attic window.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the attic bed edge in her sheer pale-apricot puff-sleeve babydoll nightgown, Tsumugi clutches the hem tightly and looks up with watery, shy eyes and flushed ears. Warm bedside lamplight glows softly beneath the starry window.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sheer pale-apricot double-gauze babydoll nightgown with delicate puff sleeves and a softly gathered pastel neckline.
